description: Team Sitara OPS is Shreya Saxena, building solo. In August 2023, wildfire forced me out of my home in Kelowna. That night, maps showed where the fire was, but nothing could tell me if this was normal. This challenge was that exact question. Over the weekend I built Ember alone: the data pipeline, the harmonization model and its validation, the web app, the design and the mascot guide. One consistent record of Canadian fire, 2000 to today. Satellites die. Their memory shouldn’t.
